en: A black-and-white photograph postcard showing a scenic view of a small European town nestled amongst hills and trees. Dominating the left side of the image is a large, historic building with a tower, likely a castle or palace, possibly attached to a church, situated atop a hill overlooking the town. The village contains several houses, and there are forested hills and open fields in the background. The text 'Lauenstein i. Erzgeb.' is printed in red at the top.
